Title: The Last Evening

Cast

1. Tarun - 70 years, grandfather
Look: white kurta, glasses
2. Priya - 42 years, mother
Look: blue saree
3. Vanusha - 8 years, granddaughter
Look: pink frock

Places

1. The bedroom - a big bed, a window

SCENE 1: The bedroom - Night

[Tarun lies in bed, very ill.]

Vanusha: "Grandpa, please get well."

[Tarun smiles at Vanusha, closes his eyes and passes away.]

Priya: "Papa..."

[Priya covers him with a white sheet.]

SCENE 2: The courtyard - Day

[Priya cuts her finger while chopping vegetables and it starts bleeding.]

Vanusha: "Mother, your finger!"

[Vanusha puts a bandage on Priya's finger.]
